clips.title: The story
paras: In Darnassus, Lotherias needs leather gear for young adventurers setting out across Kalimdor. She offers the pattern for a Moonglow Vest in return for shipments of embossed leather goods.

In Darnassus, leatherworkers work to outfit sentinels and young scouts. Night elves and allied wanderers leave Teldrassil for the wilds of Kalimdor, where sturdy armor is in demand. Lotherias is among the master leatherworkers supplying them with gear.

Lotherias asks apprentices to bring matched embossed gloves, boots, and cloaks as proof of their skill. Those who meet her order earn her trust, and she teaches them a night elf pattern for the Moonglow Vest, made to protect while allowing free movement.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We in Darnassus, especially we craftsman, are quite busy. Young adventurers are eager to test themselves in the wilderness, and are in constant need of supplies.
If you can help me fill my orders of leather goods, then perhaps I can teach you an advanced leatherworking technique.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, these are good pieces. You have a skilled hand and an eye for detail. Your future as a leatherworker is promising.
Here, friend. Let me show you the pattern to make the :Moonglow Vest.
